back.en: Oxidation of glucose in cells to release energy as ATP
back.bm: Pengoksidaan glukosa dalam sel untuk membebaskan tenaga sebagai ATP

back.en: Muscle contraction, active transport, cell division, protein synthesis, nerve impulses, body heat
back.bm: Pengecutan otot, pengangkutan aktif, pembahagian sel, sintesis protein, impuls saraf, haba badan

back.en: Starts in the cytoplasm (glycolysis), completed in mitochondria
back.bm: Bermula dalam sitoplasma (glikolisis), dilengkapkan dalam mitokondria

back.en: About 38 ATP per glucose (much more than fermentation's 2)
back.bm: Kira-kira 38 ATP per glukosa (jauh lebih banyak daripada 2 ATP fermentasi)

back.en: Extra O₂ needed after vigorous exercise to oxidise lactic acid
back.bm: O₂ tambahan selepas senaman cergas untuk mengoksidakan asid laktik

front.en: Why does fermentation release less energy?

back.en: Glucose is only partly broken down; energy remains in lactic acid or ethanol
back.bm: Glukosa hanya diuraikan separa; tenaga masih tersimpan dalam asid laktik atau etanol

back.en: Bread, tapai, yogurt, tempeh, cheese, biofuel (ethanol)
back.bm: Roti, tapai, yogurt, tempe, keju, bahan api bio (etanol)

back.en: Adenosine triphosphate — the energy carrier of cells; ATP → ADP + phosphate releases energy
back.bm: Adenosina trifosfat — pembawa tenaga sel; ATP → ADP + fosfat membebaskan tenaga

tip.en: Think of ATP as the cell's rechargeable battery.
tip.bm: Anggap ATP sebagai bateri boleh cas semula sel.

back.en: Respiration: chemical process in cells that releases energy. Breathing: moving air into and out of the lungs
back.bm: Respirasi: proses kimia dalam sel yang membebaskan tenaga. Pernafasan: menggerakkan udara masuk dan keluar dari peparu

back.en: Limewater turns chalky, or hydrogencarbonate indicator turns from red to yellow
back.bm: Air kapur menjadi keruh, atau penunjuk hidrogen karbonat bertukar dari merah ke kuning

back.en: During vigorous exercise oxygen supply cannot meet demand → lactic acid builds up → fatigue and cramp
back.bm: Semasa senaman cergas bekalan oksigen tidak mencukupi → asid laktik terkumpul → keletihan dan kekejangan

back.en: Aerobic: needs O₂ → CO₂ + water, 2898 kJ. Fermentation: no O₂ → lactic acid or ethanol (+ CO₂), 150 or 210 kJ
back.bm: Aerob: perlukan O₂ → CO₂ + air, 2898 kJ. Fermentasi: tanpa O₂ → asid laktik atau etanol (+ CO₂), 150 atau 210 kJ
